briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent release intensifies US-China AGI compute arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute buildouts hit record pace. Regulatory scrutiny grows while safety gaps persist across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V4 matches GPT-4o performance at 40% lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; xAI Colossus cluster expands to 1.2M H100 equivalents; Microsoft announces $15B Texas data center expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve reliable self-correction before regulatory caps on training runs take effect?
